lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa aae taa tinahi pathaae chaale tinai bulaai laiaa ||
lines.translation: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa bakhasanahaarai bakhas laiaa ||10||
lines.translation: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ehu chaakhiaa raam rasaain tin kee sa(n)gat khoj bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh budh giaan guroo te paaiaa mukat padaarath saran paiaa ||11||
lines.translation: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh guramukh sam kar jaanaa harakh sog te birakat bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aap maar guramukh har paae naanak sahaj samaai laiaa ||12||7||
lines.translation: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee dakhanee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam saach driRaaiaa saach sabad ras leenaa ||1||
lines.translation: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa gur daiaal sadaa ra(n)g leenaa ||
lines.translation: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis rahai ek liv laagee saache dekh pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rahai gagan pur drisat samaisar anahat sabad ra(n)geenaa ||2||
lines.translation: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sat ba(n)dh kupeen bharipur leenaa jihavaa ra(n)g raseenaa ||3||
lines.translation: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: milai gur saache jin rach raache kirat veechaar pateenaa ||4||
lines.translation: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ek mahi sarab sarab mahi ekaa eh satigur dekh dikhaaee ||5||
lines.translation: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jin keee kha(n)d ma(n)dal brahama(n)daa so prabh lakhan na jaaee ||6||
lines.translation: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: deepak te deepak paragaasiaa tribhavan jot dikhaaee ||7||
lines.translation: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sachai takhat sach mahalee baithe nirabhau taaRee laaee ||8||
lines.translation: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: mohi gaiaa bairaagee jogee ghat ghat ki(n)guree vaaee ||9||
lines.translation: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran prabhoo kee chhoote satigur sach sakhaaee ||10||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: auhath hasat maRee ghar chhaaiaa dharan gagan kal dhaaree ||1||
lines.translation: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ketee sabad udhaaree sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa maar haumai sokhai tribhavan jot tumaaree ||2||
lines.translation: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa maar manai mahi raakhai satigur sabad veechaaree ||3||
lines.translation: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)ngee surat anaahad vaajai ghat ghat jot tumaaree ||4||
lines.translation: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: parapa(n)ch ben tahee man raakhiaa braham agan parajaaree ||5||
lines.translation: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil ahinis deepak niramal jot apaaree ||6||
lines.translation: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: rav sas lauke ihu tan ki(n)guree vaajai sabad niraaree ||7||
lines.translation: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: siv nagaree mahi aasan audhoo alakh aga(n)m apaaree ||8||
lines.translation: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree ihu man raajaa pa(n)ch vasahi veechaaree ||9||
lines.translation: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sabad ravai aasan ghar raajaa adal kare gunakaaree ||10||
lines.translation: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal kahe kahi bapure jeevat mooaa man maaree ||11||
lines.translation: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||
